origin: New synthetic fixtures authored for this repository by an evaluation-role agent. Formal anchors, manual predicates and gold membership tables were frozen before reading implementation results.
independence: Separate implementation/evaluation roles and files, same model family and session; not independent human or external benchmark validation.
candidate_obligations: Curated adversarial mutations separate from core implementation; paired ablation uses identical candidates and evidence.
gold: Explicit truth membership tables independently generated using manually written predicates, not the production DSL evaluator.
sealed_policy: Private archive outside Git; hash commitment only; unused and unopened for C1 dev evaluation.
limitations: Natural-language anchor fidelity not independently validated
Repeated conceptual families and bilingual templates are correlated cases
Gold source independence is procedural, not an external annotation authority
content_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, separators comma/colon; stable across LF/CRLF.
holdout_revision: v1 development-related unused archive retained; v2 distinct conceptual family created after preliminary dev inspection and before final multi-baseline evaluation, unused. See commitment lineage.
candidate_generation_blinding: LLM role read only blind_generation_prompts.json and its own direct outputs during self-review. No gold, supplied formal C, curated O, core source, or result access during generation. Same model family/session; no human validation.
fairness_corrections: Generated candidates use their declared/prompt quantifier, never the curated mutation obligation_quantifier; existential candidates use finite quantified outcome, not a single failing valuation.
